e.title: FUEDI（欧洲公估专家联合会）：12 国公估协会地图、宪章与巨灾委员会
e.title_en: FUEDI (European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts): a map of twelve national adjusting associations, a constitution and a catastrophe committee
e.title_hk: FUEDI（歐洲公估專家聯合會）：12 國公估協會地圖、憲章與巨災委員會
e.summary: 欧洲公估（loss adjusting）专家的伞状组织：成员协会页面逐国列出 12 个国家级协会（含英国的 CILA 为 UK & Ireland 成员），并设宪章、执行委员会、资格页面、公估师角色说明与巨灾委员会
e.summary_en: The European umbrella body for loss adjusting experts: its member-association pages list twelve national associations country by country (with the UK’s CILA as the UK & Ireland member), and it provides a constitution, an executive committee, a qualifications page, an explanation of the loss adjuster’s role and a catastrophe committee
e.summary_hk: 歐洲公估（loss adjusting）專家的傘狀組織：成員協會頁面逐國列出 12 個國家級協會（含英國的 CILA 為 UK & Ireland 成員），並設憲章、執行委員會、資格頁面、公估師角色說明與巨災委員會
e.body:
**FUEDI（The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts，欧洲公估专家联合会）** 是**欧洲公估行业的伞状组织**（站点标题实测 **「FUEDI | The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts」**）。本条目补的是**「区域伞状公估组织 + 各国协会名录」这一形态**——**实测池内该形态为 0**，**而它同时提供一份「欧洲各国公估协会有哪些」的现成地图**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **147.1KB**；⭐ **「All Associations（全部协会）」页 `/member-associations/all-associations/` 实测 207.2KB**；⭐ **「Members Organisation Qualification（成员组织与资格）」页 `/members-organisation-qualification/` 实测 294.6KB**（**本条目四页中体量最大**）。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的成员协会名单（共 12 个国家级协会，逐国列出）**：**Austria AFILA（奥地利）**、**Belgium GEBCAI（比利时）**、**Denmark DALAX（丹麦）**、**France FEDEA（法国）**、**Germany BTE（德国）**、**Greece HALA（希腊）**、**Italy AIPAI（意大利）**、**Luxembourg CEL（卢森堡）**、**The Netherlands NIVRE（荷兰）**、**Portugal CNPR（葡萄牙）**、**Spain APCAS（西班牙）**、⭐ **UK & Ireland CILA（英国与爱尔兰，即同轮 [[cila]]）**。**导航逐字实测揭示的其余结构**：**About Us** 下含 **About Fuedi**、**Benefits**、⭐ **Constitution（宪章）**、⭐ **Executive Committee（执行委员会）**、**History**、**Qualifications**、**Member Associations**；⭐ **A Loss Adjusters Role（公估师的角色）**；⭐ **Catastrophe Committee（巨灾委员会）**；**News & Events** 下含 **News**、**Publications**、**Events**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「欧洲公估行业的协会地图」这一现成资源**——**12 个国家级协会逐国列出（含各自的缩写：AFILA／GEBCAI／DALAX／FEDEA／BTE／HALA／AIPAI／CEL／NIVRE／CNPR／APCAS／CILA）**；**对做欧洲理赔市场或跨境公估协调的学生，这张名单本身就是研究起点**（**可与池内 [[aae]] 的欧洲精算协会名录对照——两者都是「欧洲各国协会名录」，但一个是精算、一个是公估**）。**② ⭐ 与同轮 [[cila]] 构成「国家协会 ← 区域伞状」的完整一对**——**且这一关系是双向往返的：CILA 条目说明其会员类型与资格，FUEDI 条目说明它在 12 国中的位置**；**这是池内少见的「同轮两条目互为上下游」的结构**。**③ ⭐ 「巨灾委员会（Catastrophe Committee）」值得单独注意**——**公估行业设巨灾专门委员会，说明「巨灾后的理赔能力」被当作行业级议题**；**这与池内巨灾侧（[[perils-ied]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[oasislmf]]、[[openquake-engine]] 等**模型与**资本**工具）完全互补——**那些算损失，这个管「巨灾来了谁来定损」**；**对做巨灾风险全链条的学生，这是一个此前缺失的「人力与组织」环节**。**④ 「Qualifications」页 294.6KB 是本站点体量最大的页面**——**提示该联合会在各国资格互认或资格说明上有较多内容**（**注意：本次未打开正文，故不主张其有互认机制**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与两个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、导航逐字实测的 12 国成员协会名单与站点结构**，**但未打开宪章、执行委员会页、资格页正文、巨灾委员会页、任何成员协会页面或任何出版物**，因此**不能转述任何宪章条款、资格要求、互认安排、委员会职能或协会详情**；**② ⭐ 12 国名单来自导航逐字实测与各国页 URL 实测**，**但本次未打开任何一国协会页面核实其名称、规模或现状**——**「AFILA」等缩写的全称本次未核实**；**③ 「Qualifications」页 294.6KB 为实测体量**，**其中有多少是资格内容、多少是页面框架未区分**；**④ 「是否有资格互认机制」本次未核实，故本词条不主张**；**⑤ 该联合会的法定地位（是否为协会）、成立年份与秘书处所在地本次未核实**；**⑥ 该站点为 WordPress 建站，且含 cookie 同意组件**（实测见 `cookiedatabase.org` 引用）；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** FUEDI 提供精算工具、数据或可下载名录**。**核实说明**：首页（147.1KB）、`/member-associations/all-associations/`（207.2KB）、`/members-organisation-qualification/`（294.6KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题、导航与 12 国名单（**另单独重取首页至独立文件名以确认名单，避免临时文件复用污染**）；**未打开宪章、委员会页、资格正文、成员协会页或出版物**。
e.body_en:
**FUEDI (The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts)** is **the umbrella body for the European loss adjusting industry** (measured site title **"FUEDI | The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts"**). This entry adds the **"regional umbrella adjusting body with a national association directory"** form — **that form measured zero**, **and it supplies a ready map of which loss adjusting associations exist across Europe**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **147.1KB**; ⭐ the **"All Associations" page `/member-associations/all-associations/` measures 207.2KB**; ⭐ the **"Members Organisation Qualification" page `/members-organisation-qualification/` measures 294.6KB** (**the largest of the round’s four pages**). **The member association list read verbatim from navigation and links (twelve national associations, listed country by country)**: **Austria AFILA**, **Belgium GEBCAI**, **Denmark DALAX**, **France FEDEA**, **Germany BTE**, **Greece HALA**, **Italy AIPAI**, **Luxembourg CEL**, **The Netherlands NIVRE**, **Portugal CNPR**, **Spain APCAS** and ⭐ **UK & Ireland CILA** (**the same round’s [[cila]]**). **The rest of the structure read verbatim**: under **About Us** — **About Fuedi**, **Benefits**, ⭐ **Constitution**, ⭐ **Executive Committee**, **History**, **Qualifications** and **Member Associations**; ⭐ **A Loss Adjusters Role**; ⭐ **Catastrophe Committee**; under **News & Events** — **News**, **Publications** and **Events**.

For RIAA: **① it adds a ready resource: the map of European adjusting associations** — **twelve national associations listed country by country with their abbreviations (AFILA, GEBCAI, DALAX, FEDEA, BTE, HALA, AIPAI, CEL, NIVRE, CNPR, APCAS, CILA)**; **for work on European claims markets or cross-border adjusting coordination, the list is itself a research starting point** (**comparable with the European actuarial directory in [[aae]] — both are directories of national European associations, one actuarial, one adjusting**). **② ⭐ With [[cila]] it forms a complete "national association ← regional umbrella" pair** — **and the relationship runs both ways: the CILA entry explains its membership grades and governance, while the FUEDI entry places it among twelve countries**; **an uncommon structure in the corpus where two entries in the same round are each other’s up- and downstream**. **③ ⭐ The "Catastrophe Committee" deserves separate note** — **an adjusting industry running a dedicated catastrophe committee indicates that "claims capacity after a catastrophe" is treated as an industry-level issue**; **this is fully complementary to the corpus’s catastrophe side** (modelling and capital tools such as [[perils-ied]], [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[oasislmf]] and [[openquake-engine]]) — **those compute the loss; this governs who assesses it**; **a previously missing "people and organisation" link in the catastrophe chain**. **④ The "Qualifications" page at 294.6KB is the site’s largest page** — **suggesting substantial content on qualification descriptions or mutual recognition across countries** (**note: the body was not opened, so no mutual recognition mechanism is claimed**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and two pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the twelve-country member list and site structure read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no constitution, executive committee page, qualifications text, catastrophe committee page, member association page or publication**, so **no constitutional clause, qualification requirement, recognition arrangement, committee remit or association detail can be restated**; **② ⭐ the twelve-country list comes from measured navigation and country-page URLs**, **but no individual association page was opened to verify its name, size or current status** — **the expansions of abbreviations such as "AFILA" were not verified**; **③ the 294.6KB size of the Qualifications page is measured**, **but content versus page frame was not distinguished**; **④ whether a mutual recognition mechanism exists was not verified, so none is claimed**; **⑤ the federation’s legal status, founding year and secretariat location were not verified**; **⑥ the site runs on WordPress with a cookie-consent component** (a measured `cookiedatabase.org` reference); **⑦** this entry **does not claim FUEDI provides actuarial tools, data or a downloadable directory**. **Verification note**: the homepage (147.1KB), `/member-associations/all-associations/` (207.2KB) and `/members-organisation-qualification/` (294.6KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with the title, navigation and twelve-country list read verbatim (**the homepage was additionally re-fetched to a separate filename to confirm the list, avoiding contamination from temp-file reuse**); **no constitution, committee page, qualification text, association page or publication was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**FUEDI（The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts，歐洲公估專家聯合會）** 是**歐洲公估行業的傘狀組織**（標題實測 **「FUEDI | The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts」**）。本條目補的是**「區域傘狀公估組織 + 各國協會名錄」這一形態**——**實測該形態為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **147.1KB**；⭐ **「All Associations」頁 207.2KB**；⭐ **「Members Organisation Qualification」頁 294.6KB**（**本輪四頁中體量最大**）。**導航與連結逐字實測的成員協會名單（共 12 個，逐國列出）**：**Austria AFILA／Belgium GEBCAI／Denmark DALAX／France FEDEA／Germany BTE／Greece HALA／Italy AIPAI／Luxembourg CEL／The Netherlands NIVRE／Portugal CNPR／Spain APCAS**，⭐ **UK & Ireland CILA（即同輪 [[cila]]）**。**導航逐字實測其餘結構**：**About Us** 含 About Fuedi／Benefits／⭐**Constitution**／⭐**Executive Committee**／History／**Qualifications**／Member Associations；⭐ **A Loss Adjusters Role**；⭐ **Catastrophe Committee**；**News & Events** 含 News／Publications／Events。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「歐洲公估行業的協會地圖」這一現成資源**——**12 個國家級協會逐國列出**（可與 [[aae]] 的歐洲精算協會名錄對照——**兩者都是「歐洲各國協會名錄」，一個精算、一個公估**）。**② ⭐ 與同輪 [[cila]] 構成「國家協會 ← 區域傘狀」的完整一對**——**且關係雙向往返**，**是池內少見的「同輪兩條目互為上下游」結構**。**③ ⭐ 「巨災委員會」值得單獨注意**——**公估行業設巨災專門委員會，說明「巨災後的理賠能力」被當作行業級議題**；**與池內巨災側（模型與資本工具）完全互補——那些算損失，這個管「巨災來了誰來定損」**，**是此前缺失的「人力與組織」環節**。**④ 「Qualifications」頁 294.6KB 為本站最大頁**（**未打開正文，故不主張有互認機制**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與兩個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的 12 國名單與站點結構**，**但未打開憲章、執行委員會頁、資格頁正文、巨災委員會頁、任何成員協會頁或出版物**，故**不能轉述任何憲章條款、資格要求、互認安排、委員會職能或協會詳情**；**② ⭐ 12 國名單來自導航與各國頁 URL 實測**，**但未打開任何一國協會頁核實其名稱、規模或現狀**——**「AFILA」等縮寫全稱未核實**；**③ 294.6KB 中多少是資格內容、多少是頁面框架未區分**；**④ 是否有資格互認機制未核實，故不主張**；**⑤ 法定地位、成立年份與秘書處所在地未核實**；**⑥ 站點為 WordPress 建站並含 cookie 同意組件**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** FUEDI 提供精算工具、數據或可下載名錄**。**核實說明**：三個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取（**另單獨重取首頁至獨立檔名以確認名單，避免臨時檔案複用污染**）；**未打開憲章、委員會頁、資格正文、成員協會頁或出版物**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（首页 147.1KB 标题「FUEDI | The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts」；⭐/member-associations/all-associations/ 207.2KB「All Associations」；⭐/members-organisation-qualification/ 294.6KB「Members Organisation Qualification」；导航逐字实测成员协会 12 个：Austria AFILA / Belgium GEBCAI / Denmark DALAX / France FEDEA / Germany BTE / Greece HALA / Italy AIPAI / Luxembourg CEL / The Netherlands NIVRE / Portugal CNPR / Spain APCAS / UK & Ireland CILA；About Us 含 Constitution / Executive Committee / History / Qualifications；另有 A Loss Adjusters Role 与 Catastrophe Committee）+ ★与同轮 cila 构成「国家协会 ← 区域伞状」一对（CILA 为 FUEDI 的 UK & Ireland 成员，双向确认）；未打开宪章、执行委员会页、资格页正文、巨灾委员会页、任何成员协会页或出版物；12 国缩写全称未核实、是否有资格互认机制未核实、法定地位与成立年份未核实；另注：本站首页曾单独重取至独立文件名以确认名单（避免我自己的临时文件复用污染）
